User Data Length and Bytes when setting User Data All StbM APIs that update the StbM internal User Data structure of a Time Base (i.e., StbM_SetGlobalTime , StbM_UpdateGlobalTime , StbM_BusSetGlobal- Time , StbM_SetUserData and StbM_CloneTimeBase ) shall • set the userDataLength of the StbM internal User Data structure to the value defined by the userDataLength element of the User Data parameter of the API • set as many bytes in the StbM internal User Data structure as defined by the userDataLength element of the User Data parameter of the API • leave the bytes of the StbM internal User Data structure beyond user- DataLength given by the API at their previous value.
